# API List / Public APIs

A developer community or index: devs reward technical detail and penalise marketing tone.

Notes from the directory list: PR if you have a public API.

## Steps
1. Open https://github.com/public-apis/public-apis, read CONTRIBUTING and the inclusion criteria.
2. Write the exact list line in the list's format (alphabetical position, description length) and save it as a draft.
3. Open the PR only if the user approved it and GitHub access exists, then mark `submitted --listing-url <PR url>`.

## Make the listing perform
- Lead with what it does technically and how to try it (repo link, install command, live demo).
- If the product is open source, link `product.repo_url` prominently.
